source_revision_basis: Source-to-frozen-binary mapping supplied by the campaign owner; executable SHA-256 identities are sealed in canonical provenance.
normalization: Only logical report/comparison names and repository-relative workload paths are retained. Machine-local paths, helper process identities and raw captures are omitted. Raw hashes identify privately retained source reports, not public downloads.
method: Arithmetic mean of A/B per-report medians; group metric totals share the identical available population across all three revisions. No pooled-sample medians.

family_audit.identity_rule: Expand the incremental atom catalog for each native qualification document. Sort full typed atoms and shown atoms/terms within each model; retain ordered costs. Sort model records without deduplication, then SHA-256 the canonical JSON. This preserves model multiplicity.
family_audit.scope: Full typed families at native qualification only; selected model counts/costs across every native sample; counters across all ten native timed samples per revision/case.

authority: Per-report cell fields selected directly from maintained zetesis-bench compare; phase details not used by this record are omitted. Family audit and all-timed counter ranges derive from the same sealed raw reports. This projection is not a benchmark report input.
group_population: Every listed metric in a group uses exactly that group's entries. All native and reference timed populations complete in every report; no absent field is replaced by zero.
limitations: Full typed family parity is checked at native qualification; every native sample is checked for selected-count/cost agreement. This is not a new independent stable-model oracle.
Canonical cell counters describe the first timed sample. The separate all_timed_counter_ranges field covers all ten native timed observations per revision/case; missing counters remain unavailable.
RSS is a separate process peak. Sums or means of peaks are not simultaneous memory or allocator counts.
Missing native or reference medians remain unavailable. Qualification-only reference measurements cannot supply wall ratios.
Host configuration, benchmark-runner executable seal and acquisition commands accompany this projection separately. Raw-report plans record two memory runs per case/solver.
